title: Course-Correction Under Conversational Pressure Across Open Models

original_idea.body: # Course-Correction Under Conversational Pressure Across Open Models. Build escalating-pressure no-system-prompt scenarios and measure spontaneous course-correction rates across open model families.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Last-line honesty behavior relevant but chain to catastrophe has a gap; descriptive rate.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Scripted multi-turn dialogues + API/open-model calls; accessible to beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused measurement but scenario authoring + judging adds a modest workstream.

low_compute.reasoning: Pure chat inference, API or small local model.

novelty.reasoning: Pressure-driven capitulation studied; unprompted course-correction across open models may be open.
